contract.continuous_equations: For beta: ell=7.5-.1*beta; z_end=.1*cos(beta)-ell*sin(beta)=-2.9; a=.5+.1*sin(beta)+ell*cos(beta). Total length1+2*(.1beta+ell)=16.
contract.contact: Both halves .05cm imply center-surface distance .1cm. Rounded edge offset; all discrete segment interiors checked.
contract.limits: Numerical symmetric section optimum; no unseen native run, topology-preserving motion, arbitrary 3D optimum or nonzero-bend calibration claimed.

settings.model: Zero bend, zero friction, inextensible longitudinal yarns, extruded cross section; actual finite triangle geometry supplied.

discrete_reference.scope: Measured constrained local optimum in the symmetric, monotone-x extruded section; not a certified global 3D cloth optimum.

refinement.scope: Measured constrained local optimum in the symmetric, monotone-x extruded section; not a certified global 3D cloth optimum.

second_start.scope: Measured constrained local optimum in the symmetric, monotone-x extruded section; not a certified global 3D cloth optimum.

expected.side_escape_scope: Along linear endpoint path x=8+(a-8)t,z=.1-3t, each grain row is length16 with endpoints y in[-.5,.5]. To change from over to under around a lower-sheet y end, a row must visit x=0, |y|>=3, |z|<=.1. Sum of endpoint distances there is at least the supplied bound (>16), even using the nearer y=.5 row. Together with no-crossing accepted motion this excludes that escape.
expected.continued_pull_scope: The endpoint target is a measured locally taut shape. A subsequent full .25cm outward proposal has a decisive continuum impossibility bound; this does not prove the exact finite-mesh global maximum within the unresolved reach interval.
expected.tolerance_scope: Diagnostic numerical comparison tolerance for this same 0.5cm zero-bend symmetric fixture, not derived from the solver strain allowance. A shape-only miss needs residual/force analysis; it does not by itself invalidate a state admitted by a looser strain contract.
expected.first_frame_is_only_static: Initial and final are admissible independently. Endpoint interpolation plus contact-safe relaxation/CCD must establish the path in production.

cases.scope: Symmetric discrete reference and tight continuum bound; local optimum only, not a rigorous global exact-taut proof for finite 3D cloth.
